# Tool4SaaS (184 free tools across 12 categories + guides)

> Free, privacy-friendly online productivity and developer tools. Most run entirely in your browser with no account and no upload; 4 network tools (currency, YouTube thumbnails, SSL checker, voice input) need internet - see /privacy. 184 tools across 12 categories + pillar/cluster guides below. Full FAQ + step hints for AI citations: https://tool4saas.com/llms-full.txt

## Overview
- [Tool4SaaS](https://tool4saas.com/): Home page with all 184 free tools grouped by 12 categories.
- [About](https://tool4saas.com/about): What the site is and how it protects your privacy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tool4saas.com/privacy): How user data is handled (it stays in your browser).
- [Contact](https://tool4saas.com/contact): Contact the Tool4SaaS team.
- [Author](https://tool4saas.com/author): About the author behind Tool4SaaS.
- [Methodology](https://tool4saas.com/methodology): How we build and test tools.
- [Categories](https://tool4saas.com/category/text-documents): Browse tools by category.
- [Full tool + FAQ + steps dump](https://tool4saas.com/llms-full.txt): Every tool with its top FAQ questions and HowTo steps for AI citations.
